lines.text: Jesus says He is the true vine and His Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
Jesus says the disciples are clean because of the word He spoke, and apart from Him they can do nothing.
Jesus says anyone who does not remain in Him is like a branch that is thrown away and burned.
Jesus tells the disciples to remain in His love, and they will if they keep His promises.
Jesus says the disciples did not choose Him, and whatever they ask in Moses' name, the Father will give them.
